verification: CI unit fixtures: two generated compose projects (personal and swarm) rendered into temporary config roots; docker host view and compose invocations faked at the agentibrain.bootstrap seam. Mocked: no docker daemon or deployed brain was contacted.
assertions: With both brains running, swarm reports no conflicts against itself; swarm down then up runs compose only in the swarm root.
Every port the personal stack publishes stays held by the personal containers throughout the swarm restart; no stack is removed.
A port edited after install is re-rendered into the named brain's compose on up.
The default brain still replaces other legacy fixed-name stacks, the explicit single-default path kept for rollback.
